sourceText: Execute the approved remediation roadmap continuously. When B-914f exposed that the documented explicit-human-approval plus three-round single-host fallback could not produce keyId, validationDigest, and promptDigest, create the next story to solve that workflow blocker without fabricating a second host.
normalizedOutcome: The printed degraded single-host review command derives fresh canonical bindings, writes one real host verdict per round, and three rounds satisfy only an explicitly approved fallback.
acceptanceClaim: With current story evidence and explicit derive mode, autopilot_review_submit emits canonical gate-admissible bindings identical to quorum derivation for the same host, rejects stale conflicts before writes, and never creates a second host.
